summary.text: Megan Wingfield is the Democratic nominee for Kentucky's 2nd Congressional District and a mechanic from Bowling Green. Her campaign website describes her as a caregiver and activist who is running on working families, affordable healthcare and a fair shot for every Kentucky family.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, Wingfield was born and raised in Bowling Green, Kentucky. She graduated from Southcentral Kentucky Community and Technical College with a degree in Automotive Technology and built her career as a mechanic.
